svg.title: Zero-shot transfer: most seeds coincide with fresh search, a few do not
svg.desc: For each of five seeds and two held-out workloads, the utilisation of an action transferred without retraining and of a freshly searched action. In most seeds the two coincide; gaps appear in two seeds of the different-regime workload and one of the same-regime workload.

g.text: D > A: above the knee, like the source
D < A: below the knee, the opposite regime
Total gap across seeds: 3.11 pp (same regime) vs. 4.37 pp (different regime) — the predicted direction, but not significant at n = 5 (p = 0.69, 0.59).

svg.text: Source: experiments/exp6_generalization/results/raw/exp6_n15_merged.csv · each row a seed · fresh search at 15 iterations
